summary.intent: Review and update codebase maps, identify E2E testing gaps and new concerns from FEATURES.md and CONCERNS.md, capture todos, add new roadmap phases, and begin discussing/planning the new phases via the GSD manager.
summary.outcome: Added 6 todos for E2E/staging work, added 5 new roadmap phases (28-32) to the v1.1 milestone, captured CONTEXT.md for phases 28/29/30 via discuss workflow, spawned background planners for phases 28/29, and fixed a lint-staged issue that was corrupting ROADMAP.md. PRs #380 (docs) and #381 (roadmap phases) merged to main.

repo: Only 1 of 12 E2E specs (recovery.spec.ts) calls deleteTestAccount(); the rest leave orphaned test accounts. A deleteTestAccount() helper already exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts.

AES-CTR streaming mode is selected for media files >256KB, GCM for everything else, implemented in streaming-crypto.service.ts. Service worker at decrypt-sw.ts intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs for HTTP Range request support. 35 unit tests exist but zero E2E tests.
127 console.* calls across 29 files in apps/web/src/ — hooks.ts alone has 34 (Web3Auth debug logging). No logging infrastructure exists in the web app today.
RepublishService.unenrollIpns() exists at apps/api/src/republish/republish.service.ts:255 but has no REST endpoint. TODO at folder.service.ts:513 explicitly notes this was deferred to Phase 14.

Test login endpoint on staging is well-guarded (NODE_ENV check + timing-safe secret comparison + unit tests + cipherbox_auth_logins_total metric already emitted). E2E tests depend on it so it must not be removed.
Kubo port 5001 is already bound to 127.0.0.1 in staging Docker compose — the IPFS access control concern is lower risk than it appeared in CONCERNS.md.

Phase 28 logger decision: custom thin wrapper preferred over pino/browser because pino's redaction and Sentry integration are Node.js-only, not browser. Privacy-first app needs custom redact() interceptor regardless.

Phase 30 observability decision: Grafana Faro chosen over Sentry — single vendor (Grafana Cloud already in use), no session replay feature (privacy advantage), 50k sessions/month free vs Sentry's 5k errors/month, web vitals built-in.
All v1.1 phases 18-27 are complete. New phases 28-32 start at 28.
FEATURES.md and DEFERRED.md were added to .planning/ in the GSD update that pulled into main.

code.finding: deleteTestAccount() helper exists (DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' }) but only called by recovery.spec.ts
CTR mode threshold: files >256KB use AES-CTR, smaller files use GCM
unenrollIpns() method exists but no REST endpoint exposes it
34 console.* calls — largest single file, Web3Auth debug logging leaking SDK state
lint-staged runs markdownlint --fix on all *.md files — was corrupting .planning/ROADMAP.md by escaping asterisks. Fixed by excluding .planning/ glob from lint-staged config.

workflow: GSD manager can run discuss inline while background planners execute — effective parallelism pattern for phase work.
STATE.md todo count can become stale from previous sessions; always verify against actual file count before incrementing.

lint-staged with markdownlint --fix bypasses .markdownlintignore when explicit file paths are passed — must exclude patterns in the lint-staged glob config in package.json, not just in .markdownlintignore.
GSD init manager JSON output breaks if ROADMAP.md contains markdown-escaped characters (e.g. \*) — keep planning docs free of characters that markdownlint might escape.
Grafana Faro v2.0 went GA November 2025 — relatively new but sufficient for this use case.

friction: markdownlint lint-staged hook kept re-escaping asterisks in ROADMAP.md on every commit, breaking gsd-tools.cjs JSON parsing. Required three separate fix attempts before resolving by updating the lint-staged glob in package.json.
STATE.md todo count was stale (showed 10 when actual count was 6), causing an incorrect increment to 14 that had to be corrected.
GSD manager init JSON parsing is brittle to markdown formatting in ROADMAP.md — a single escaped character breaks the entire dashboard.
